exclude: the loading screen, which the loader LOC2 loads from the tape and copies to the screen before the program arrives; the program never reads it and draws over it from its first screen (reference/loading-screen.png is a picture of it)

the game's variables ($5B00-$5B59), its object table ($5B5A-$5EBF, 145 entries of six bytes) and the creature records ($5EC0-$606D, 86 of five bytes), all written in play from the scenario or a saved game; at the hand-over they still hold the ROM's system variables, the BASIC and the loader LOC2

a copy of the 48K ROM's main key table ($0205-$022B), the letter of each key by the number KEY-SCAN gives it, with SYMBOL SHIFT ($0E in the ROM) and ENTER ($0D) made 0: ask_file_name and the number of players read keys through it
